messages:
Maria K: T-2h kickoff — quiet window and final readiness sweep. Need: rollback owners, confirmed pin list, release notes link, and any freeze exceptions now.
Aj Patel: I'm owning rollback for canary and EU slice. I have the rollback runbook open.
Tim O: Pins: runtime=2.1.0, model=v3.4.1 (quantized), routing policy=fast-fallback. I'll paste the pin diff in a sec.
Leah R: Release notes updated: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/342 — highlights + blockers. Please review the QA bullet.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: canary pin applied to release-1234 by @tim_o at 1748500012 :white_check_mark:
Aj Patel: Quick check: embedders hotfix (small config tweak) requests freeze-exemption. Does this need a pin change?
Tim O: It only touches a config flag in infra, not the model. I'd accept an exemption if SRE signs off.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: smoke tests triggered by @maria_k — running: smoke/sanity, latency/95p, embeddings/regression.
Leah R: I ran the smoke locally earlier, saw one minor log spam but no functional failures.
Aj Patel: SRE: @tim_o can you confirm canary has traffic gating enabled so we can revert quickly if needed?
Tim O: Yep — gate at 2% then 10%. Manual traffic holdpoint at 1748500300.
Maria K: Rollback owners: Aj (canary), Tim (runtime), Leah (release notes + customer comms). Ack?
Aj Patel: Ack.
Tim O: Ack.
Leah R: Ack.
Maria K: Exception decision: embeddings hotfix — +1 from Aj, +1 from Tim. Anyone object?
Leah R: No objection. Keep the change scoped; Leah will co-author a short note in the release notes about the exemption.
Maria K: Ok locking freeze except for the approved embeddings hotfix. autopin disabled for the next 90 minutes.
Tim O: Shortcut commands for ops:
```
# smoke
kubectl -n prod exec -it smoke-runner -- ./run_smoke.sh --suite quick
curl -sS https://internal.redwood/health | jq .status
```
Maria K: Verify that rollout playbook link is up-to-date: https://wiki.redwood/rollout-playbook. If someone sees an outdated step call it out now.
Aj Patel: Playbook ok. Added note about KV cache warm-up.
Leah R: Final release note bullet: "Embeddings config tweak allowed during freeze for urgent production regression." Added.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: canary traffic increase scheduled at 1748500300 -> 10% if no signals.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: smoke results: quick suite passed (0 failed), latency 95p below SLO.
Tim O: Manual watch assigned: me and Aj for first 12 minutes after traffic increase.
Maria K: Go/no-go pls (short):
Aj Patel: GO :rocket:
Tim O: GO (watching) :eyes:
Leah R: GO :thumbsup:
Maria K: Locking quiet window. I'll post a short blurb for the customer-facing slack channel once traffic reaches 10%. Good job team — stay sharp for the first 15 minutes after the bump.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: notification posted to #customers-notify at 1748500118 (scheduled).
